responsibility: This subtarget header configures the m68k/ColdFire backend for ELF-based uClinux systems that are post-processed into FLAT executables. It overrides start/end files, library and linker specs, defines uClinux and ID-shared-library preprocessor builtins, makes -msep-data the default PIC mode through driver self-specs, and tightens section-relative relocation assumptions for the elf2flt model. It is the OS/binary-format adaptation layer for the special uClinux/FLAT deployment environment.
same_name_distinction: Supplies the uClinux subtarget configuration header: start/end file specs, LIB_SPEC/LINK_SPEC overrides, OS predefines, default -msep-data driver self-specs, and relocation-section rules for the FLAT/elf2flt environment. Unlike uclinux.opt it configures specs and preprocessor/target macros rather than merely declaring the driver options accepted for that environment.
